features.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature hit by the infiltrator's Mind Blade attack this turn. Failure: The target takes 14 (4d6) Psychic damage and is cursed. A cursed creature repeats the save whenever it finishes a Short or Long Rest, ending the effect on itself on a success. Success: Half damage only.
